.. py:class:: SgeConnection

   SSH host/username/password for one SGE cluster connection.


   .. py:attribute:: host
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: user
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: password
      :type:  str


.. py:class:: SgePendingJob

   A submitted GUI SGE job being tracked for completion (id, connection, status, results).


   .. py:attribute:: job_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: tool_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: remote_job_root
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: connection
      :type:  SgeConnection


   .. py:attribute:: output_name
      :type:  str
      :value: 'output.nii.gz'



   .. py:attribute:: status
      :type:  str
      :value: 'submitted'



   .. py:attribute:: done_payload
      :type:  dict[str, Any] | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: local_download_dir
      :type:  str | None
      :value: None



.. py:class:: SgeDoneMarker

   Parsed contents of a worker's ``.done`` marker file (exit code, output files, error).


   .. py:attribute:: job_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: exit_code
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: output_files
      :type:  list[str]
      :value: []



   .. py:attribute:: finished_at
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



   .. py:attribute:: error
      :type:  str | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: from_dict(data: dict[str, Any]) -> SgeDoneMarker
      :classmethod:


      Parse a JSON-decoded ``.done`` payload into an :class:`SgeDoneMarker`.



   .. py:method:: to_dict() -> dict[str, Any]

      Serialize this marker back to a plain dict (inverse of :meth:`from_dict`).



.. py:function:: remote_done_path(remote_job_root: str) -> str

   Remote path of the ``.done`` marker file for a job rooted at *remote_job_root*.


.. py:function:: remote_output_dir(remote_job_root: str) -> str

   Remote output directory for a job rooted at *remote_job_root*.


.. py:function:: verify_local_downloads(local_dir: Path, done: SgeDoneMarker) -> list[Path]

   Ensure every file listed in *done* was downloaded with non-zero size.
